question: Who was accused of tampering with the pictures?
solution:
The correct answer is option 3) i.e**. '****A freelance photographer'.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **first sentence of the first paragraph** says " Reuters was forced to withdraw more than 900 pictures taken by a freelance photographer after it was suspected that he had ‘doctored’ two recent photographs of the Israeli-Lebanon conflict."
 
• The **first sentence of the second paragraph mentions the name of the photographer, ****Adnan Hajj.**
 
• From the above sentence, we can say that **Adnan Hajj, a freelance photographer was accused of tampering with the pictures.**

 

*Hence, the only possible answer is **option 3**.*
